seo.title: Contact us: start a project or ask a question
seo.description: Send a project enquiry, ask for a free website audit or get support. Every message reaches the right person, with a reply usually within one business day.

hero.title: Contact Calwebtech
hero.intro: Tell us what you need and your message goes straight to the people who handle it. Every enquiry gets a reply from a person, usually within one business day.

image.alt: A small project team working together at shared desks in an open-plan studio

form.heading: Send us a message
form.intro: Choose what it is about so it reaches the right person first time. Only your name and email are required.
form.messagePlaceholder: A few sentences about what you need is plenty.
form.footnote: Protected by bot filtering. We never sell or share your details, and you can ask us to delete them at any time.

success.heading: Thanks. Your message is with us.
success.body: It has gone to the person who handles this kind of enquiry. You will get a reply by email, usually within one business day.

details.heading: Talk to a person
details.response: Usually within one business day, from a person rather than an autoresponder. We sign your NDA before we talk if you need one.

routing.heading: Where does my message go?
routing.intro: The topic you choose is saved with your message and shown to the team that handles it, so the right person can pick it up.

descriptions.body: Read by the people who scope and price projects. Expect a reply to book a thirty minute call, then a written proposal within two business days of it.
Add your current website address. We review speed, accessibility, search and how the site asks for enquiries, and reply with the problems worth fixing first.
For existing clients. Critical issues on a site under warranty get a response within four hours; everything else joins your care plan queue.
For agencies, freelancers and technology companies who want to work with us on client projects.
Tell us about your experience and the kind of work you want to do. A person who handles hiring reads it, and writing to us does not add you to any mailing list.
For journalists and event organisers. Tell us your deadline and the questions you have.

nextSteps.heading: What happens after I send a message?

steps.title: A person reads it
steps.body: Your message is saved with the topic you chose and shared with our team. Nothing is added to a mailing list and no automated sequence starts.

steps.title: We reply, usually within one business day
steps.body: You get an answer by email from someone who can help, or a time for a short call if that is quicker.

steps.title: You decide what happens next
steps.body: For a project, a written proposal follows the call. If we are not the right fit, we say so and point you somewhere better.
